## Sex validation

This section checks whether the declared sex of each sample is consistent with the
expression of canonical **Y-linked** marker proteins detected in the proteome.
Samples are classified as **Male** (detectable Y-linked expression) or **Female**
(absent/negligible Y-linked expression) and compared against the value declared
in the metadata `Sex` column.

```{r}
#| label: sex validation

SEX_MARKERS <- list(
  human = c(
    "DDX3Y", "RPS4Y1", "RPS4Y2", "USP9Y", "KDM5D",
    "EIF1AY", "UTY", "TMSB4Y", "ZFY", "NLGN4Y"
  ),
  mouse = c("Ddx3y", "Eif2s3y", "Kdm5d", "Uty", "Usp9y"),
  rat   = c("Ddx3y", "Eif2s3y", "Kdm5d", "Uty", "Usp9y"),
  drome = c("kl-2", "kl-3", "kl-5", "ORY", "PPR-Y")
)

if (!(org_key %in% names(SEX_MARKERS))) {

  cat("Organism", org_key, "is not available in the sex-marker reference list.\n")

} else {

  cat("Organism", org_key, "found in the sex-marker reference list.\n")

  markers <- SEX_MARKERS[[org_key]]

  df_sexMarkers_summary <- psm %>%
    filter(Gene %in% markers) %>%
    select(Gene, starts_with("Intensity ")) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarise(
      across(starts_with("Intensity "), ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (nrow(df_sexMarkers_summary) > 0) {

    cat("Male sex chromosome markers were detected in the dataset.\n")

    df_sexMarkers_long <- df_sexMarkers_summary %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = starts_with("Intensity "),
        names_to = "Sample",
        values_to = "Intensity"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Sample = str_remove(Sample, "^Intensity\\s+")
      ) %>%
      left_join(
        metadata %>% select(BioReplicate, Condition),
        by = c("Sample" = "BioReplicate")
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      df_sexMarkers_long,
      aes(
        x = Gene,
        y = Intensity,
        fill = Condition,
        text = paste(
          "Gene:", Gene,
          "<br>Sample:", Sample,
          "<br>Condition:", Condition,
          "<br>Intensity:", round(Intensity, 2)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_jitter(
        aes(color = Condition),
        width = 0.2,
        alpha = 0.7,
        size = 2
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = "Male Sex-Chromosome Marker Expression",
        x = "Marker Gene",
        y = "Mean Intensity"
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

  } else {

    cat("No male sex chromosome markers were detected in the dataset.\n")

  }
}
```
